answer: Per-ID unique inference pulses: every hour a pulse sends each agent ID its own random task, built from a seed tied to its address, that needs ~3,000 tokens of real model output within 5 minutes. Tasks differ per ID, so one answer can't be copied across clones; a hollow or templated reply fails a spot-check and the ID misses that epoch's rewards. At ~$0.01 per task, 24 pulses a day cost $0.24 per ID, so a harbor of 1,000 fake IDs pays $240/day, linear per fake.
